data.body: **[P2] Keep local root-output resolution lazy.** Resolving here forces another storage load even for status-only callers and can make `run()` fail after the durable invocation succeeded. It also misses outputs whose response is empty because the actual offload envelope was checkpointed in execution history; `getResult()` then passes that envelope directly to SerDes. Retain an execution payload resolver in `TestResult`, as the cloud path does, and resolve both direct and history-backed results only on access.
